title: Apocalipsispa Mosoqmanta Qelqasqan Lazo
intro: Piensariy ancha importante runaman encargakusqaykipi, chaymantañataqmi huk kamachikuywan tupanki, chaymi kasukuyrayku hukllawakuyta tukuchin. Huk revelacionmi huk wasi hunt’ata mosoqmanta ruwarqan, kamachikuypa chawpinpi kaq sutitaqmi mana hayk’aqpas rimasqa hinachu karqan.
clues: Sayarqanim maypichus sapakamapa hunt’aq kayqa Diospa kasukuyninman qukunan karqa.
Willakuqpa wasinpim riqsisqa karqani uywasqa churi hina.
Yacharqanim casarakuyniyqa Allahpa kachasqanman apachisqa revelacionpa temanman tikrakusqanmanta.
Uyarirqanim ‘Esposaykita waqaychay hinaspa Allahta manchakuy’ nisqa simikunata, ñuqaman dirigisqa.
Chaymantam yacharurqani Allahqa Allahpa kachasqanta wakin warmikunata divorciananpaq kamachisqanmanta, chaymi kikiypa casarakuyniypas chay kamachikuywan tukunan karqa.
Ñuqaqa Zayd ibn Harithah kani, chay adoptado churi, Surah Al-Ahzb nisqapi sutichasqa.

trial.label: Prueba/Evento nisqa
options: Warminta waqaychananpaq nisqa, chaymantataq divorciakunanpaq kamachisqa
trial.answer: Warminta waqaychananpaq nisqa, chaymantataq divorciakunanpaq kamachisqa

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Chay kamachikuyta kasukuspan esposanmanta t’aqakapurqan, chaymi casarakuyqa ch’usaqyapurqan
Nina hornomanta mana ima k’irisqa qespichisqa karqan
Hatun challwa millp’usqan qhepamanmi qespichisqa karqan
Inti lluqsimuy ladopi, inti chinkaykuy ladopipas kamachikuyta qorqanku
outcome.answer: Chay kamachikuyta kasukuspan esposanmanta t’aqakapurqan, chaymi casarakuyqa ch’usaqyapurqan

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
